description: Work out an IFTA quarterly return: fleet MPG, taxable gallons, tax due or credit and surcharges by jurisdiction. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version, reference-value notes (official figure or your figure, with source and effective date), a check link and a source-page URL. Official reference values are prefilled when omitted; supply every other figure from the user's records. Percent fields take percent numbers. No figures are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

jurisdictions.description: Jurisdictions traveled this quarter. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for jurisdictions traveled this quarter. Unknown is not the same as zero.

label.description: Jurisdiction or reference label (no names needed). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for jurisdiction or reference label (no names needed). Unknown is not the same as zero. Optional reference label; no names or personal data.

miles.description: Total miles in this jurisdiction (mi). All miles driven by qualified vehicles in the jurisdiction this quarter.

rate.description: Tax rate per gallon (your figure from the IFTA rate matrix) (currency/gal). Enter the rate for your fuel type and quarter from the IFTA tax rate matrix at iftach.org.

surcharge.description: Surcharge rate per gallon, if any (your figure) (currency/gal). Some jurisdictions add a surcharge on taxable gallons. Enter 0 if none.

taxPaidGallons.description: Tax-paid gallons bought in this jurisdiction (gal). Gallons bought at retail with that jurisdiction's fuel tax included, from your receipts.

taxableMiles.description: Taxable miles in this jurisdiction (mi). Usually equal to total miles. Some jurisdictions exempt certain roads or miles; use their rule.

mpgRound.description: Fleet MPG rounding. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for fleet mpg rounding. Unknown is not the same as zero. Options: two = Round to 2 decimals (IFTA Procedures Manual P720.350); none = Do not round.

otherGallons.description: Other gallons used, not bought tax-paid (bulk or untaxed) (gal). These count in fleet MPG but earn no tax-paid credit.

wd.description: Add a weight-distance tax section. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for add a weight-distance tax section. Unknown is not the same as zero. Options: no = No; yes = Yes (Oregon, Kentucky, New York or New Mexico).

weightDistance.description: Weight-distance taxes (filed separately from IFTA). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for weight-distance taxes (filed separately from ifta). Unknown is not the same as zero. Used only when wd is yes; ignored otherwise.

label.description: Reference label (no names needed). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for reference label (no names needed). Unknown is not the same as zero. Optional reference label; no names or personal data.

miles.description: Taxable miles for this tax (mi). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for taxable miles for this tax. Unknown is not the same as zero.

ratePerMile.description: Rate per mile (your figure from the state) (currency/mi). Look up the rate for your weight and axle class on the state's own page.

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.

name: buscalc_ifta_quarterly_fuel_tax_worksheet

checkURL.description: Link that replays this calculation on https://buscalc.com/sumtru/verify/. Null when the inputs hold free-form text or the link would be too long.

notes.description: Reference-value notes first, then model notes and the standard limit statement.

referenceValues.description: One entry per official reference value in play: the official figure, the figure used, status official or user, source, effective date and the note text.

sealURL.description: Where a saved record of this result can be sealed with an independent timestamp.
